name: Linh Nguyen (synthetic)

facts.label: communicate with customers
facts.story: Answers customers on chat, email and phone about returns, delivery problems and warranties for an online electronics shop.

facts.label: process refunds
facts.story: Handles returns and refunds together with the warehouse and the finance team.

facts.label: guarantee customer satisfaction
facts.story: Tracked down a lost parcel and arranged same-day delivery for an angry customer, then explained what had happened.

facts.label: apply conflict management
facts.story: Calms down tense customer situations and writes a short explanation of what went wrong.

facts.label: keep records of customer interaction
facts.story: Adds a note in the ticket system so that the next agent knows the history.

answers.recent_work: I work in the customer service team of an online electronics shop, on chat and email, and I answer calls on busy days. I handle returns, refunds, delivery problems and warranty questions. I'm 23, I grew up in Vantaa and my parents come from Vietnam. I did my business studies at a university of applied sciences and started here on an internship.
answers.example: A customer wrote three times that his laptop had not arrived, and he was very angry. I checked the tracking and found the parcel had gone to a wrong pick-up point. I phoned the point, found the parcel, and arranged a courier to bring it the same evening. Then I wrote him a short message explaining what happened, and I added a note in the system so the next agent would know.
answers.tools: A ticket system, chat, phone, the order system and the courier's tracking pages. I have macros for common answers but I always change them to fit the case. Excel for the monthly report of the return reasons.
answers.people: We are a team of twelve with two team leads. I talk with the warehouse about missing parcels and with the finance team about refunds. The customers are everyone from students to companies. I am the person who answers the first message and decides whether to solve it or pass it on.
answers.beyond: In my studies I did a course on service design and a project for a local shop about its returns process. I also volunteer as a youth sports coach once a week, where I deal with parents' questions.
answers.open_floor: I keep a personal list of common problems and answers, and I shared it with the team. They added their own tips, so it's now the page the new people open first.
answers.looking_for: I'd like to stay in customer service but with more responsibility, maybe a team handling bigger customers or something like customer success. I work in English and Finnish. Hybrid is best, and I could start with one month's notice.

probes: For the courier I asked for the same-day option, confirmed the address with the customer by phone, and called the courier to confirm pick-up by five. The customer got the laptop at eight in the evening.

For the report, each month I count the return reasons from the tickets, group them into six types and make a small table with a short comment. The product team uses it to fix the product descriptions.
